remarks: Welcome to this lovely, impeccably maintained one-bedroom, 1.5 bath townhome in the highly sought-after Chesterfield complex. Filled with natural light, this inviting home offers a bright and airy layout, spacious living and dining areas, with recessed lighting and a fireplace. The well appointed kitchen, has a beautiful hard wood floor and newer appliances. The convenient main-level updated powder room is sure to please your guests. Sliding glass doors open to a private deck, creating the perfect space to relax or entertain while enjoying the peaceful surroundings. The spacious primary bedroom offers ample closet space and an en-suite full bath. Laundry is in unit and located on the second floor. Nestled within one of Stamford's most desirable gated communities, Chesterfield is beautifully landscaped and meticulously maintained, featuring a gated entrance with 24hr Guard for added security, two sparkling swimming pools, tree-lined streets, and sidewalks that create a welcoming neighborhood feel. Ideally located just minutes from downtown Stamford, shopping, dining, parks, Metro-North, and major commuter routes, this move-in-ready home offers the perfect blend of comfort, convenience, and low-maintenance living.
